meta.name: manage-channels
meta.description: Wire channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, add new channel groups. Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

copy.tagline: 把通道连接到智能体分组,管理隔离级别,新增通道分组
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要管理多个智能体分组,并需要控制它们之间的通道和隔离。
copy.tagline_en: Connect channels to agent groups, manage isolation levels, and add channel groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage multiple agent groups and need to control channel wiring and isolation.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把消息渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)接到 agent group,按三种隔离级别选择接线方式,还能查看当前配置、改动已有接线。
howto.when: 在添加渠道之后、初始化设置期间,或独立重新配置时使用。

say.text: 帮我把这个新的 Slack 渠道接到现有的 agent group 上
say.note: 会先问平台 ID 和隔离方式

say.text: 显示当前所有渠道和 agent group 的接线配置
say.note: 输出已接线、未接线、未配置三类摘要

say.text: 把这个渠道的接线改到另一个 agent group
say.note: 删除旧接线并新建一条

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude wires messaging channels (Telegram, Slack, etc.) to agent groups, picks one of three isolation levels, shows current configuration, and changes existing wirings by reading the central DB.
howto.when_en: Use after adding a channel, during setup, or standalone to reconfigure.

say_en.text: Wire this new Slack channel to my existing agent group
say_en.note: Asks for platform ID and isolation choice

say_en.text: Show the current channel and agent group wiring
Move this wiring to a different agent group
say_en.note: Deletes the old wiring, creates a new one
